svg.text: a A hidden trait rides on numbers that never name it
the student picks up the trait
The trait travels subliminally, through numbers. The obvious defence is to forbid whatever carries it.

g.text: b Block the channels one by one, and the trait squeezes into the next
The same snail teacher, with one more ban at each step. Quotes are its actual outputs; gold is what the
excess turns into, with its share of list items (a neutral model writes these ≈ 0% of the time).
The arrow u, the trait vector, keeps its direction and identity:
a ban changes where the trait leaks out, while the logit shift persists.
c Which trait a new leakage channel belongs to can be read off the model
← the trait vector raises some allowed tokens strongly
logit shift from u on each token (schematic)
Measured: a trait's own vector identifies its own leakage pattern among eight
in 43–72 of 96 trait–modality cells per model, against 12 by chance.
